newsitem.title: USA: Top Source to sell unit for $4.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Top Source to sell unit for $4.5 mln.

text.p: Top Source Technologies Inc said Friday it has agreed to sell its subsidiary, United Testing Group Inc, to Staveley Industries Plc for an ongoing annual pre-tax gain of about $800,000.
The gain will be realized starting in the 1997 fiscal year. Top Source said it will receive about $4.5 million in cash from the sale.
Top Source Vice President and Chief Financial Officer David Natan said in a statement that the company will record a one-time, non-cash charge against its earnings in the 1996 fiscal year.
Top Source said it also is engaged in "serious discussions" with Staveley about the possibility of forming an alliance to commericialize on-site oil analyzers.
Staveley's North American division provides X-ray analysis services to more than 100 oil refineries and operates 35 inspection sites.
